common.rg_body: IASHARK publishes statistical football analysis. We are not a bookmaker and we do not take bets, and a probability is never a certainty. Betting involves risks (losing money, addiction). You must be 18 or over.

welcome.subject: Welcome to IASHARK: where to start
welcome.preheader: How to use the site, the free match and our methodology.
welcome.title: Welcome to IASHARK

blocks.text: Your free IASHARK account is ready. Here is how to use the site in a few minutes.

items: On some days, the full analysis of one match is free: it is then highlighted on the home page.
On a match page, read the probabilities estimated by the model, the factors it takes into account and their limits.
The Methodology page explains where these figures come from and how to read them.

blocks.text: The current free match:
You did not ask to receive our free analyses and tips by email, so we will only send you emails about your account. You can change your mind at any time in My account, under Notifications.

blocks.text: On some days, IASHARK opens the full analysis of one match to every account, free of charge. Here is today's:
You will find the estimated probabilities, the factors used by the model and the points to watch. These are statistical estimates: the outcome of a match remains uncertain.
To see every analysis: free {{trialDays}}-day Pro trial (monthly plan), for a first subscription only, cancel in 1 click.

pro_features.subject: What IASHARK Pro unlocks
pro_features.preheader: The list of Pro content and its price, plainly.
pro_features.title: What Pro adds to your free account

blocks.text: Your free account gives you the full analysis of a match offered on some days, the blog and a preview of the tools. Here is what Pro adds:

items: The full analysis on every match
The selected pick, with its probability and its reasons
The most likely scores and expected goals
The most likely scorers, including the 3 scorers of the day

blocks.text: Prices on the {{siteVersion}} version of the site: {{proWeekPrice}} per week, {{proPrice}} per month or {{proYearPrice}} per year. The same Pro access whichever period you choose, cancel at any time from My account.
Prices on the {{siteVersion}} version of the site: {{proWeekPrice}} per week or {{proPrice}} per month. The same Pro access whichever period you choose, cancel at any time from My account.
Price on the {{siteVersion}} version of the site: {{proPrice}} per month, cancel at any time from My account.
Pro gives you more analyses and tools; it does not make any match more predictable.

Free {{trialDays}}-day trial on the monthly plan, for a first subscription: your card is required, nothing is charged during the trial, an email reminds you 2 days before it ends and you cancel in 1 click from My account. Weekly and yearly plans are paid on subscription.
If the free account is enough for you, there is nothing to do.
